This draft needs confirmed business contacts and operating details, plus legal review, before public launch or customer onboarding.

About this notice

Sena is a hospitality software brand of Nile Africa Technologies Ltd., Nigeria. This notice explains personal information associated with this website and distinguishes it from information managed by a property using Sena.

This edition covers the current website preview. It does not replace a property’s guest privacy notice or a signed data processing agreement for a live Sena account.

Information on this website

The calendar, room, housekeeping and booking demonstrations use illustrative data. Changing their values updates the page in your browser; these demonstrations do not create a real reservation, collect a payment or submit guest details to Sena. Demo scheduling and account registration are not connected on this edition of the website.

Hosting and access services may process technical information such as IP address, browser information, request times and access records to deliver and protect the site. This private preview also uses its hosting provider’s access controls. Sena has not added advertising trackers or analytics scripts to the site.

Purposes and legal grounds

Technical information is used to provide the website, keep it secure and investigate faults. Where applicable, this processing relies on legitimate interests in operating a secure service, subject to individuals’ rights, or on a legal obligation. Consent should be requested before optional tracking that requires it is introduced.

If enquiry, account or payment features are introduced, this notice must explain their information categories, purposes and applicable lawful bases before collection begins.

Hospitality and guest information

For a live property account, the hospitality operator will ordinarily determine why guest information is collected and how it is used. Sena’s role in processing information on that operator’s behalf must be set out in a separate agreement. Contact your hotel or serviced property for requests about its reservations, guest records, cancellation decisions or payments.

Do not enter real guest, identity, card or sensitive information into the website demonstrations.

Sharing and international processing

Website hosting and security providers may handle technical information needed to operate this website. Information may also be disclosed where lawfully required. The production provider list, processing locations and any international transfer safeguards must be confirmed before the live service launches; this draft does not assert that data is stored only in Nigeria.

Retention and security

Demonstration state lasts only for the current page session and resets on reload. Sena has not added browser storage for these demonstrations. Hosting or access records are subject to the hosting provider’s retention arrangements.

Production retention periods, deletion procedures and security responsibilities must be documented before real customer or guest information is accepted. No online service can guarantee absolute security.

Your choices and rights

Subject to applicable law and any relevant exceptions, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your personal information, object to certain processing, and withdraw consent where processing depends on it. Withdrawal does not affect earlier lawful processing. Identity verification may be needed to protect your information.

You may raise a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission. Where a hospitality operator controls the information, direct the request to that operator.

Children

This business website is intended for adult hospitality operators, rather than children. Do not submit children’s personal information through the website preview. Any handling of children’s guest information by a property requires appropriate safeguards and a documented lawful basis.

Contact and updates

The public privacy email and registered business address are awaiting confirmation from Nile Africa Technologies Ltd. These details must be completed before this notice is used for a public launch.

We will identify revisions by updating the date on this page. Material changes involving new collection or use should be explained before those activities begin.
